d: AXING 16 X DVB-S/S2/S2x/C/T to IP Streamer

specs.label: Inputs frequency range
specs.value: 900 … 2150 MHz @ DVB-S/S2/S2X; 50 … 898 MHz @ DVB-C; 50 … 898 MHz @ DVB-T/T2

specs.label: Max. LNB current
specs.value: 250 mA per input; 1000 mA per device

specs.label: Input modulation type
specs.value: QPSK/8PSK/8APSK/16APSK/32APSK @ DVB-S/S2/S2X; QAM16, QAM32, QAM64, QAM128, QAM256 @ DVB-C; QPSK, QAM16, QAM64 @ DVB-T; QPSK, QAM16, QAM64, QAM256 @ DVB-T2

specs.label: Input modulation symbol rate
specs.value: 1.5 … 45 MS/s (< 40 MS/s in 32APSK) @ DVB-S/S2/S2X; 1 … 7.2 Mbaud @ DVB-C
